name: Floors route → ESCALATE: not clean, budget exhausted → park toward the human
description:
The escalate route (design R1/SB5, group 5). When the attempt was NOT clean (route.attempt.unclean=true) AND the attempt budget is exhausted (route.attempt.instance count ≥ B, via length_gte the PER-TASK budget), the dev loop cannot converge by rule. This PARKS the run toward the human: it records run.awaiting.human on the run and posts to the exact semdev park-post request lane. No Go reconciler advances a run whose dev loop exhausted its budget (G2/B3/B7). This is the honest terminal of the bounded loop — an unconverged task NEVER passes verify or ships a hollow PR, it parks (the semspec disease inverted).

TRIGGER = the developer loop L_n: route.attempt.unclean eq "true" (required:false) AND route.attempt.transient eq "false" (required:false — a TRANSIENT loop failure is diverted to 06f/06g and does NOT reach the convergence escalate; the flag is check_floors' atomic-mirror classification, always present with route.attempt.passed, so the exclusion is a condition partition, never a stamp race — see 06c/06f; adopt-reason-aware-escalate) AND route.attempt.instance length_gte $entity.triple.route.task.budget.value (required:true — count ≥ B, where B = task.spec.budget mirrored as route.task.budget; #519 scalar .value + #568 length_gte) AND route.attempt.routed length_eq 0 (self-extinguish).

REASON-AWARE PARK (adopt-reason-aware-escalate, #569): the run.awaiting.human object carries the loop's classified terminal reason via $entity.triple.agent.loop.terminal-reason.value — 'max_iterations' means the attempts ran out of turns (consider a larger iteration budget, #528), an empty reason means the attempt completed but measured red or a floor rejected it. Substitution is firing-entity-only (#519) and the reason is on this developer loop, so it resolves with no mirror; G3 — the reason is the engine's classified fact, never synthesized. Mutually exclusive with retry (06c, length_lt B): the two length conditions partition the count with no gap. length_gte B (not length_eq B) is strictly FAIL-CLOSED — even if the +1-per-dispatch invariant were ever violated and the count over-shot, escalate still catches count > B and retry provably cannot fire, so a run can never retry past budget nor hang.

WRITER: run.awaiting.human's writer is the park-rule subsystem (G5) — one of the sanctioned park realizations (alongside run-lifecycle/03 ask_human, sandbox/02 unprovable, and the review-park 07c / delivery-park 08b). All mean the identical thing (this run awaits a human, here is why) and upsert the one park marker the whole system reads; they differ only in TRIGGER. Rule add_triple carries no Source, so the vocab keeps the single entry with no writer drift.

RUN BINDING: the park marker goes on the RUN (subject-override the developer loop L_n's agent.run.entity-id).

SELF-EXTINGUISHING ONE-SHOT (restart-safe): on_enter FIRST stamps route.attempt.routed=$entity.instance on the developer loop L_n, guarded by route.attempt.routed length_eq 0. A LOOP-scoped guard (not run.awaiting.human) is required because this rule fires on the developer loop L_n, which does NOT carry the run-scoped park marker — a run-scoped guard would read absent on the loop and re-post to the semdev park-post request lane every rescan.

on_enter.subject: $entity.triple.agent.run.entity-id
on_enter.object: the dev loop exhausted its attempt budget without a clean attempt; last engine terminal reason: '$entity.triple.agent.loop.terminal-reason.value' (max_iterations = ran out of turns; empty = the last attempt completed but measured red or a structural floor rejected it)

metadata.station: route escalate — not clean + budget exhausted → park (R1/SB5, group 5)
metadata.trigger_rationale: route.attempt.unclean eq true AND route.attempt.instance length_gte $entity.triple.route.task.budget.value (count ≥ B, the PER-TASK budget mirrored as route.task.budget). Partitions the count with retry's length_lt B; length_gte B is fail-closed (catches an over-count too). Replaces the old constant length_gt 2 (#519 scalar .value + #568 length_gte).
metadata.writer_note: run.awaiting.human is written by the park-rule subsystem (G5) — a sanctioned park realization. Rule add_triple carries no Source, so the single vocab entry is not drifted.
metadata.restart_safe: SELF-EXTINGUISHING via the LOOP-scoped route.attempt.routed marker (not run.awaiting.human, which lives on the run and would never extinguish on the loop).
